senses.gloss: m. (v. preced.; cmp. jugum a. ζυγόν, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Tela) cross-beam of the loom, also the cross-rod under the cross-beam (liciatorium) to which the ends of the leashes are fastened; trnsf (mostly pl.) נִירִים, נִירִין the leashes or thrums to which the threads of the warp are fastened; also the warp.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94:8">Gen. R. s. 94</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q02182"><he>פָּתַל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b:7">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>אין לוקחין … ולא נ׳</he> you must not buy from the weaver remnants of woof or of warp threads.
Kel. XXI, 1 הנוגע בנ׳ … he who touches the upper beam … or the rods, contrad. to קֵירוֹס.—בית נ׳ that portion of the web produced by passing the spool with the woof across the warp, mesh, slip.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 13:2">Sabb. XIII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 105a:13">105ᵃ</cite>) <he>העושה שני בתי נ׳ בנִירַיִּים וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בנירין</he>) he who starts a web by making two meshes, attaching them either to the cross-pieces or to the slips (<cite ref="S01170"><he>קֵירוֹס</he></cite>). Ib. 105ᵃ <he>ברוחב ג׳ בתי נ׳</he> within a distance of three meshes; (Tosef. ib. XII (XIII), 1 <he>על ג׳ בתים</he>). Y. ib. VII, 10ᶜ <he>שני נ׳ בחף … בניר אחד</he> two sets of warp threads fastened to one old border web (licium) or two borders fastened to one set of warp threads.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 8:5">Shek. VIII, 5</cite> <he>על ע״ב נ׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <he>נימין</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., p. <he>לד</he>, note) the curtain was woven on seventy-two leashes, and each twist of the warp (<cite ref="N00676"><he>נִימָה</he></cite>) contained twenty four threads; <cite ref="Chullin 90b:15">Ḥull. 90ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tamid 29b:6">Tam. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>נימין</he>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:13">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>נימין</he>; Tanḥ. Vayaḳh. 7 <he>נימין</he>; ed. Bub. 10 <he>נירים</he>.
